groom.name: Manu
groom.parents: in loving memory of his father

bride.name: Vella
bride.parents: daughter of a loving family in Bandung

door.mat: come in, we left it open
door.kicker: You are invited to the home of

hints: Drag to look around — everything with a story glows when you're close. The dogs know where the good ones are.
Looking for the date and place? They're pinned to the corkboard by the front door — or use the shortcuts below.
The guestbook on the dining table is how you RSVP — your wish becomes a frame on their wall.

memories.title: The house with the loud heart
memories.caption: The kampung in Bandung where Vella arrived with the morning prayers — second of three, loudest from day one. Her father drew this the week she was born.

memories.title: The doorway
memories.caption: The small one is her little brother. The bullies at school knew exactly one thing about him: his sister stood in doorways and did not move.

memories.title: Ink before sleep
memories.caption: Eleven journals, one rubber band. Stories nobody assigned, written under a mosquito net by flashlight. She wrote the world bigger than her street.

memories.title: Night shifts
memories.caption: Her hospital lanyard, retired to the key bowl. White uniform, quiet corridors — she learned that care is a language you speak with your hands.

memories.title: Der, die, das
memories.caption: The original flashcards, promoted to fridge magnets. Midnight grammar with two dogs asleep on the homework — and a language-practice chat app she installed just to have someone to write to.

memories.title: A Mannheim winter
memories.caption: Snow over the old water tower. Manu arrived in Mannheim in 1991 — a Rhine-side city kid with January in his blood.

memories.title: Kept wound
memories.caption: His father's watch. Manu was three when it stopped being worn. He taught himself to wind it — and in thirty years he has never once let it stop.

memories.title: The quiet fixer
memories.caption: The radio he brought back to life at fourteen, in the children's home where he grew up. A mind that never idles — the doctors had a word for it — found its calm in making broken things speak again.

memories.title: His name in the corner
memories.caption: Nineteen, first job, first drawings signed with his own name. Nobody handed Manu a head start — so he sat down and drew one.

memories.title: The first message
memories.caption: She typed her practice German into a chat app. A stranger in Mannheim corrected her gently — then never stopped replying. Some apps match people. This one just let two people keep talking.

memories.title: Two passengers, four paws
memories.caption: 10,742 kilometres in cargo-approved comfort. Sugar saw snow first and refused to comment. Omi barked at it on principle. Home now lives in two places.

memories.title: The welcome committee
memories.caption: Two leashes, two bowls, two opinions. Sugar — the fluffy one — approves of all guests. Omi — the sleek one — approves of most. You seem to be doing fine.

reveal.guard: Not yet — a few more memories first. (Omi is very serious about this.)
reveal.proposalCaption: A winter garden strung with lights, December 2026. He asked in German. She answered in Indonesian. Both meant the same word. Omi interrupted; nobody minded.

Sugar: Sugar approves of you. Sugar approves of everyone — but still, it's nice.
The fluffy one is Sugar: professional greeter, zero standards, full heart.
Sugar has lived on two continents and rated the snacks on both. Five stars.
Sugar says: the good memories are the ones that glow.
Omi: Omi is reserving judgment. (Between us — you're doing well.)
The sleek one is Omi: head of security, keeper of the ring box.
Omi has heard all these stories before. Tail wags anyway.
Omi barked at German snow once, on principle. It stopped by April.

wishes.name: Sugar & Omi
wishes.message: We crossed an ocean for these two. Worth it. (Woof, twice.)

wishes.name: The pack back home
wishes.message: We kept the warm half of home ready. Come visit soon — bring the twins.

wishes.name: Ibu & Bapak
wishes.message: Our brave girl found the word she was looking for. Blessings, always.

wishes.name: The Mannheim crew
wishes.message: He fixed our radios, our bikes, and our spirits. She fixed him. Prost!

wishes.name: Frau Bauer
wishes.message: I watched this boy grow up steady against the odds. Nobody deserves this day more.

wishes.name: Rina
wishes.message: Six time zones can't dilute this friendship. Save me a dance on video call.

closing: Make yourself at home — we can't wait to make room for you on the big day.
